description_en: Retrieves notification information by calling GetNotification
name: GetNotification

Category.description_en:
The notification category. Valid values:

GATEWAY_OFFLINE: gateway offline information.
JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_APPLYING: credential authorization in progress.
JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_ACCEPTED: credential authorization succeeded.
JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_CANCELED: credential authorization revoked.
JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_REJECTED: credential authorization rejected
Category.description_zh:
通知分类。取值：

GATEWAY_OFFLINE：网关离线信息。
JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_APPLYING：凭证授权中。
JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_ACCEPTED：凭证授权成功。
JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_CANCELED：撤销凭证授权。
JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_REJECTED：拒绝凭证授权

GatewayOfflineInfo.description_en:
The gateway offline information.

This field has a value when the Category field is set to GATEWAY_OFFLINE
GatewayOfflineInfo.description_zh:
网关离线信息。

当Category字段为GATEWAY_OFFLINE时，该字段有值

GwEui.description_en: The unique identifier of the gateway

OfflineMillis.description_en: The offline time, as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
OfflineMillis.description_zh: 离线时间，毫秒为单位的UNIX时间戳

HandleState.description_en:
The handling status of the notification. Valid values:

HANDLED: handled.

UNHANDLED: not handled
HandleState.description_zh:
此通知的处理状态。可取值为：

HANDLED：已处理。

UNHANDLED：未处理

HandledMillis.description_en: The time when the notification was handled, as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
HandledMillis.description_zh: 通知被处理的时间，毫秒为单位的UNIX时间戳

JoinPermissionAuthInfo.description_en:
The credential authorization information.

This field has a value when the Category field is set to JOINPERMISSION_AUTH
JoinPermissionAuthInfo.description_zh:
凭证授权信息。

当Category字段为JOINPERMISSION_AUTH时该字段有值

AcceptedMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the ticket was approved, in milliseconds
AcceptedMillis.description_zh: 工单审批通过的UNIX时间戳 ，毫秒为单位

ApplyingMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the ticket was submitted, in milliseconds
ApplyingMillis.description_zh: 发起工单的UNIX时间戳，毫秒为单位

CanceledMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the ticket was canceled, in milliseconds
CanceledMillis.description_zh: 工单被取消的UNIX时间戳，毫秒为单位

JoinEui.description_en: The JoinEUI used by the join permission credential

JoinPermissionId.description_en: The unique ID of the join permission credential

JoinPermissionName.description_en: The name of the join permission credential

OrderState.description_en:
The ticket status. Valid values:

APPLYING: the ticket has been submitted and is pending approval.
ACCEPTED: the ticket has been approved.
REJECTED: the ticket has been rejected.
CANCELED: the ticket has been canceled
OrderState.description_zh:
工单状态。取值：

APPLYING：工单发起，等待批准。
ACCEPTED：工单被批准。
REJECTED：工单被拒绝。
CANCELED：工单被取消

OwnerAliyunId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the join permission credential owner who initiated the authorization
OwnerAliyunId.description_zh: 发起授权的入网凭证拥有者的阿里云账号ID

RejectedMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the ticket was rejected, in milliseconds
RejectedMillis.description_zh: 工单被拒绝的UNIX时间戳，毫秒为单位

RenterAliyunId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the join permission credential tenant
RenterAliyunId.description_zh: 入网凭证租户的阿里云账号ID

NoticeMillis.description_en: The time when the notification was sent, as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
NoticeMillis.description_zh: 通知发出的时间，毫秒为单位的UNIX时间戳

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
